# Let me parse the file content to extract the songs to archive.
import re
content = file_content["content"]
lines = content.strip().split("\n")
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith("- "):
        song_entry = line[2:].strip()
        # Extract song name and artist
        match = re.match(r'(.+) by (.+)', song_entry)
        if match:
            song_name = match.group(1).strip()
            artist_name = match.group(2).strip()
            songs_to_archive.append({"song_name": song_name, "artist_name": artist_name})
print(f"Found {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive:")
for s in songs_to_archive:
    print(s)
